title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting by adding a penalty term to the loss function. This penalty discourages overly complex models.

title: Effect of Regularization on Bias
text: Regularization can help reduce variance but may increase bias. Consider how this affects the model's performance.

title: Model Complexity and Bias
text: A model with high complexity might have low bias but high variance. Regularization simplifies the model, potentially increasing bias but reducing variance.

title: Evaluating Regularization Impact
text: Does adding regularization to the model reduce the model bias squared?
